title: Greenview Aviaries Park & Zoo
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Our family run country park and zoo is located in Morpeth, Ontario (Chatham-Kent). We are home to over 75 species of animal including: tigers, lions, kangaroo, zebras, capybara, lemurs, monkeys, parrots, reptiles and many more! Our property also offers a large playground, splash pad, inflatable jumping pillow, restaurant and gift shop.
